replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
Hey there, zCrosz.
Here is is some evidence regarding your punishment to hopefully rap this up.


First of all, you were clearly seen being exceedingly rude to Murph_The_Cat by continually accusing them of using hacks, had you have used /report, the user would have been dealt with accordingly.

In addition to this, you were spamming excessively in caps which I had previously punished you for. Seeing your past infraction history with spamming, it is to be assumed that, by now, you as a user should know better as to not continually break the same rules. Taking your previous infractions into account, your latest kick for spamming should have resulted in a temp ban alone.

Another one of the comments you made was "el mod come pito" doing some quick research, I found this to be quite a rude insult.

Your appeal is denied.
